title: Test gap: 0x17 option carrying undecodable COSE blob (DecodedRootSig::from_cose_sign1 Err -> Reject) is untested
description: From edge-case review of b7z9.88.3. rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:687-689: a well-formed 0x17 root-signature option whose payload fails COSE decode must Reject (fail-closed). No test pins this arm: the tampered tests (tests.rs:3159-3184) flip the Schnorr signature inside a decodable COSE (hits verify_signature), and truncated_root_signature_option_rejects hits the OptionIter overrun arm (receive.rs:672-674) instead. Add a gate-level test: duplicate the expired-signature fixture but replace the COSE blob with well-formed-TLV-wrapped garbage bytes, assert DioRootSigOutcome::Reject and empty root-seq cache. Labels: the primary area is networking (RPL gate), secondary rust.
